description: This is a Dart source file defining a Flutter widget for a dashboard screen that checks the backend health status on init and on user refresh, displaying the connectivity status with visual indicators and error messages.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the dashboard screen that assesses backend connectivity.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the health check logic and UI for the DashboardScreen.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state, sets up the health service, and triggers the initial health check.

methods.name: _runHealthCheck
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check of the backend and updates the UI based on the response.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree displaying the connection status indicator, label, and error message if any.
